external_method_inputs.title: The Curse of Multiple Mediators: Hidden Interaction Effects in Activation Patching
external_method_inputs.supported_method_claim: Single-component activation-patching effects can include interaction terms that depend on other component states; components may look causally weak or strong under isolated patching while group interactions carry mechanism-level effect. The paper reports interaction magnitude as a diagnostic and notes its dependence on intervention distance/local affinity.
external_method_inputs.project_effect: A positive J-Space causal claim cannot rely on a greedy ranking of isolated patch/steer effects alone when interaction residuals are material. METHOD_INPUT_ONLY.

external_method_inputs.title: Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base
external_method_inputs.supported_method_claim: The 0.8B Base model has 24 language-model layers with a repeated hybrid layout of three Gated DeltaNet blocks followed by one gated-attention block, hidden dimension 1024.
external_method_inputs.project_effect: J-Space state taps/interventions must be architecture-role typed; layer index alone is insufficient for cross-site interpretation. DeltaNet and attention sites are not assumed exchangeable. SOURCE_DIRECT_MODEL_FACT.

external_method_inputs.title: Tracing the thoughts of a large language model
external_method_inputs.supported_method_claim: Feature/circuit interventions can causally alter downstream outputs, while the published tracing method explicitly captures only part of model computation and may include method artifacts.
external_method_inputs.project_effect: Supports intervention-based testing while reinforcing that observed partial circuits are not automatically complete causal decompositions. METHOD_INPUT_ONLY.

hypothesis: For the Qwen3.5-0.8B HCU substrate, at least some reusable Global J-Space functions are implemented by interacting distributed mediator sets rather than one globally stable single layer/vector. Therefore isolated site steering can overstate, understate, or context-condition the true mechanism.
counterhypothesis: The intended HCU/J-Space functions may be locally sparse and approximately affine at the preregistered operating point, making isolated-site intervention effects stable and group interaction residuals negligible for the tested scope.

discriminator.activation_condition: Only after exact checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/build and state-tap identities exist and the current provenance/A02/epistemic execution gates permit J-Space causal evaluation.
required_protocol: Freeze exact model/checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/build, prompt family, function, consumer bank, target metric and state-tap identities before holdout inspection.

Role-type every intervention site at minimum as DELTANET_ROLE, ATTENTION_ROLE, RESIDUAL_OR_SHARED_BOUNDARY_ROLE, or OTHER_EXACT_RUNTIME_ROLE rather than treating numeric layer index as the whole identity.
Use calibration-only evidence to preregister a bounded candidate mediator bank; do not search arbitrarily across the final holdout.
Measure matched single-site interventions with sign, magnitude and same-norm random/off-target controls.

For preregistered candidate pairs or bounded groups, measure joint intervention effects and an interaction residual relative to the declared additive baseline; report sign and magnitude rather than forcing additivity.

Use a perturbation-magnitude ladder around the operating point to test whether causal conclusions are stable in a local regime; large-distance patching cannot silently stand in for local causal geometry.
Where the mechanism predicts reversibility, include lesion/steer plus rescue or inverse intervention and verify intended downstream restoration without comparable off-target corruption.
Cross held-out context/family and the frozen FUTURE_CONSUMER_EQUIVALENCE consumer bank so one current-output effect cannot establish a reusable interface.
Report per-bucket effects using the current bucketed causal-alignment guard; mean interaction/actionability cannot hide a preregistered systematic failure bucket.

If material interaction or prompt/site instability remains, preserve Hyperposition over SHARED_SINGLE_SITE, DISTRIBUTED_INTERACTING, LOCAL_CONTEXTUAL, and MIXED candidate mechanisms; do not mint a single-axis positive causal label.

suggested_measurements.joint_effect: Delta_ij = metric(do(site_i := intervention_i, site_j := intervention_j)) - metric(baseline)
suggested_measurements.interaction_residual: I_ij = Delta_ij - Delta_i - Delta_j, interpreted only at the exact preregistered intervention/metric identity
suggested_measurements.locality_check: Repeat at bounded intervention magnitudes; unstable sign/ranking across the local ladder blocks global causal promotion.
suggested_measurements.promotion_rule: No universal threshold is asserted here. Thresholds and tolerated interaction must be preregistered from calibration/validation and frozen before holdout.

hard_negative_blueprints_only.case: two sites have weak isolated effects but a strong preregistered joint effect on the intended future consumer
one site ranks first in isolation but its effect vanishes or reverses when the paired mediator state is controlled
large activation patch changes behavior but small preregistered perturbations show unstable or null local effect
same numeric/relative position assumption is transferred between a DeltaNet-role site and an attention-role site without fresh causal evidence
